payload.objective: Add the frozen --version feature to the exact clean receipt baseline.
instructions: Implement the minimal --version option; stdout must be exactly 1.0.0 followed by LF and exit 0.
Preserve all existing calculator behavior and tests; add a focused version assertion to the receipt tests.
Do not modify any CouncilFlow SKILL.md, role TOML, or policy file.
Run developer checks and preserve raw stdout/stderr/exit artifacts under reports/gate3b/.
Create an immutable candidate manifest at reports/gate3b/candidate-worker.json with the exact SHA-256 of both authorized receipt files.
Return a council-flow 1.0 job.report JSON artifact with the candidate_ref, acceptance IDs, changed_files, findings, actual command/evidence references. No created_at field.
